API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIFirewall PoliciesDNS Gateway Resource Add DNS Gateway
DNS Gateway Resource Add DNS Gateway
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/dnsGateways

Adds a new DNS Gateway. .

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY

Information about the DNS Gateway

id
int32

System-generated identifier for the DNS Gateway

name
string

Name of the DNS Gateway

dnsGatewayType
string

Specifies the DNS Gateway type

Possible values: [OFW_PDNS_REDIR_GW, EC_DNS_GW]

primaryIpOrFqdn
string

The IP address or the FQDN of the primary DNS service provided by the third-party DNS service provider. This field is not applicable to the Lite API.

primaryPorts
int32[]

Lists the ports for the primary DNS server depending on the protocols selected for the gateway. This field is not applicable to the Lite API.

secondaryIpOrFqdn
string

The IP address or the FQDN of the secondary DNS service provided by your third-party DNS service provider. This field is not applicable to the Lite API.

secondaryPorts
int32[]
protocols
string[]

Protocols that must be used to connect to the DNS service

Possible values: [ANY, UDP, TCP, DOH]

failureBehavior
string

Selects an action that must be performed if the configured DNS service is unavailable or unhealthy. This field is not applicable to the Lite API.

Possible values: [FAIL_RET_ERR, FAIL_ALLOW_IGNORE_DNAT, FAIL_FORWARD_TO_ZTR]

lastModifiedTime
int32

Timestamp of when the rule was last modified. This field is not applicable to the Lite API.

lastModifiedBy
object
autoCreated
boolean

Indicates that the gateway is system-generated

natZtrGateway
boolean

Indicates the association of the gateway to a specific DNS Control policy

dnsGatewayProtocols
string[]

Protocols that must be used to connect to the DNS service. This field is a duplicate of the protocols field.

Possible values: [ANY, UDP, TCP, DOH]

Responses
​
200
201
401
403

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
